name: How do I compare full interior paint quotes without getting burned?
description: Compare scope, not just price. The best quote clearly lists prep, coats, materials, cleanup, and what is excluded so you can tell what you are really buying.

mainEntity.name: How do I compare full interior paint quotes without getting burned?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ask whether the crew includes prep work, patching, priming, cleanup, and a written workmanship warranty before you choose a package. If two bids look similar, compare the scope line by line rather than choosing the lowest number, because cheaper quotes often leave out critical steps.
